items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: I knew Willie "the Lion" and Lucky and all them guys, and in the meantime I used to go there and rehearse every Sunday. I belonged to the Clef Club.

ctx.x: said he was big Rex Stewart / in the twenties and thirties.
Oh, he was. You know, he was down in the Capital Palace. Willie (the Lion) had a band, six-piece band.
